findings.issue: Trailing ellipsis is a single U+2026 (取消中…). The zh-CN style guide's Punctuation & typography section is explicit: 'Ellipsis is …… (two marks), not "..."', and the shipped corpus follows it — 275 values use …… against 38 with a single …, and every cancel-in-progress string in the app already reads 正在取消…… (ui.settings.imports.cancelling, ui.community.composer.cancelling, ui.chat.run_details.wake.cancelling and its wake_cancel/job_cancel siblings). This is a NEW key, so it would introduce new drift rather than carry it.
findings.note: Only the ellipsis changes. 取消中 itself is correct for this status set and must be kept: the in-flight statuses here are 运行中 / 排队中, and the X中 pattern is the shipped zh-CN in-flight form (53 values). Do not rewrite it to 正在取消, which breaks the status-row pattern the neighbours set.

findings.issue: 取消中 patches the in-flight pattern of status.running (运行中) and status.queued (排队中) rather than the corpus's sentence-level 正在取消, which is the right call for a status cell; also, three pre-existing values in this same namespace (checking 检查中…, runs.loading 正在读取运行…, sheet.submitting 正在启动…) carry the single … and are unchanged r3-audited bytes — out of this delta, not a reason to keep the new key's single mark.
